summary: The normalized resource taxonomy maps vendor resource types to standard names (for example VMware VMs and EC2 instances are both virtual_machine), organized by category, and queries set facts.device_type to the snake_case value.
questions: What device_type should I use for an EC2 instance in resource reporting?
How do vendor-specific resources map to common types?
Which field holds the taxonomy type in a resource query?

answer_card.title: Normalized resource taxonomy
answer_card.answer_md: Vendor types map to standard names: a VMware VM and an AWS EC2 instance are both `virtual_machine`; an Azure LB and an F5 VIP are both `load_balancer`. Set `facts.device_type` to the `snake_case` value from the category tables.
